purpose: Frozen native-YCSB representative inputs for OpenWhisk REPLAY. Joint pin of trace + DB + 2d plan bytes by canonical ID + SHA256. OpenWhisk must replay these exact bytes; never regenerate.
no_execution_note: This file is a byte-provenance freeze only. No OpenWhisk invocation, no benchmark rerun, no DB build was performed to produce it.

database.source: identical to deployment/openwhisk/config/artifacts.json database block (executor 'orig' layout); on-disk sha256 re-verified in this freeze.

canonical_query: SELECT payload FROM items WHERE id=?1

2d.note: 2d interior-skeleton plan is DB-specific and workload-independent; valid ONLY against bound_db_sha256 (test.db, 26331 pages). Verified: max plan offset 106520576 -> page idx 26006 < 26331.

layers_5.note: layers_5 static plan: the first 5 interior pages by native (file_offset, page_number) order derived from the pinned classifier -- a STRICT PREFIX of the 92-interior 2d skeleton. Fixed delivery invariant 5/5/0/5; workload/seed/first-op independent; DB-specific, valid ONLY against bound_db_sha256 (test.db, 26331). Explicitly pinned here (sha + counts + offsets), not only transitively via the classifier sha.

2e_K10.note: 2e_K10 = resident 92-interior 2d skeleton UNION top-10 hot leaf pages; leaf half is seed-dependent. Per-seed frozen plans (sha + counts) pinned under keyed_strategy_plans; explicitly widens the allowed strategy set to {baseline,2d,layers_5,2e_K10}. Derived from the canonical native hot2e research method; never regenerated on WS2.

2f_slru.note: 2f_slru = the entire resident working set (SLRU) for the workload+seed, delivered before the measured first query (first-query foil). Interior half is the 92-page 2d skeleton (set equality, every seed); total/leaf footprint is per-seed (resident 26323-26331; seed 8 = whole DB 26331). Per-seed frozen plans (sha + counts) pinned under keyed_strategy_plans; widens the allowed strategy set to {baseline,2d,layers_5,2e_K10,2f_slru}. Derived from the canonical native slru research method; never regenerated on WS2. See config/plans/keyed/native_source/PROVENANCE.md.

2e_K500.note: 2e_K500 = resident 92-interior 2d skeleton UNION top-500 hot leaf pages (deep leaf union; K=500 vs 2e_K10's K=10). Leaf half is seed-dependent. Per-seed frozen plans in keyed_strategy_plans[native_ycsb_c_read_zipf][<seed>][2e_K500].

leaf_freq_K10.note: leaf_freq_K10 = the top-10 hot LEAF pages only -- the leaf half of 2e_K10 with the interior skeleton removed (frequency arm of the leaf-only ablation). Per-seed frozen plans in keyed_strategy_plans[native_ycsb_c_read_zipf][<seed>][leaf_freq_K10].

leaf_rand_K10.note: leaf_rand_K10 = 10 RANDOM leaf pages of the same leaf type(s) as the top-10 hot leaves, drawn by a deterministic seeded RNG (random arm of the leaf-only ablation; interior skeleton omitted). Per-seed frozen plans in keyed_strategy_plans[native_ycsb_c_read_zipf][<seed>][leaf_rand_K10].

2f_top102.note: 2f_top102 = the top-102 resident pages by root->leaf traversal frequency (total budget-matched to 2e_K10's 102). Ranks with NO page-type knowledge, so the interior/leaf split is EMERGENT (observed 51/51 across seeds), recorded per seed but NOT enforced. Per-seed frozen plans in keyed_strategy_plans[native_ycsb_c_read_zipf][<seed>][2f_top102].

learned_markov_102.note: learned_markov_102 = the top-102 pages by first-order Markov expected-visit score from a HELD-OUT (LOSO) transition model trained on the other 9 seeds (budget-matched to 102). Ranks by transition score with no page-type knowledge, so the interior/leaf split is EMERGENT (observed 51/51 across seeds), recorded per seed but NOT enforced. Per-seed frozen plans in keyed_strategy_plans[native_ycsb_c_read_zipf][<seed>][learned_markov_102].

2f_top28.note: 2f_top28 = the top-28 resident pages by root->leaf traversal frequency (total budget-matched to the learned model). Ranks with NO page-type knowledge, so the interior/leaf split is EMERGENT (observed 26/2 across seeds 1-3), recorded per seed but NOT enforced. Portability layer only (workstation->OpenWhisk deployment complement); per-seed frozen plans in keyed_strategy_plans[native_ycsb_c_read_zipf][<seed>][2f_top28].

learned_markov_28.note: learned_markov_28 = the top-28 pages of a first-order Markov transition model trained leave-one-seed-out (train on the other 9 seeds, test on the held-out seed; the test seed is never in the training set). Emergent 26/2 interior/leaf split recorded per seed, NOT enforced. Portability layer only; per-seed frozen plans in keyed_strategy_plans[native_ycsb_c_read_zipf][<seed>][learned_markov_28].

representative_workload.external_validity_counterpart: external-validity counterpart of Scattered-Zipf (paper A) -- NOT equated
representative_workload.op_format: one op per line 'read <id>'; ids in [25,599999] subset of test.db keyspace [1,600000] (replay-compatible; verified).

base_trace.note: base trace not byte-identical to any of the 10 seeds; NOT an 11th seed.

superseded_ref.source: results/ycsb_full/data/fig17_abl_YC_orig_s{1..10}.csv (frozen breadth+seed run; CI overlaps, relative effect consistent)

headline_result_ref.scope_note: single-workload (canonical YCSB-C) 10-seed CI -- NOT a 12-config breadth CI. Re-canonicalized from the same batch that ran prior-work (libprefetch, learned_markov) head-to-head on the same frozen inputs (test.db 26331, seed traces workload_YC_{1..10}); relative %delta is machine-state-portable so the value tracks the frozen -38.4 within CI.

secondary_config_headlines.note: Same-batch ours-vs-prior-work head-to-head, extended to the other two native configs that have a 10-seed trace family (the only reads where learned_markov LOSO is possible). Same protocol as the canonical YCSB-C headline_result_ref, retargeted via tools/native_headtohead_multi.sh onto the SAME frozen inputs (test.db 26331, per-config seed traces). These do NOT supersede the canonical YCSB-C headline; they are per-access-pattern re-canonicalizations. The 9 single-trace read configs have no seed family and cannot carry LOSO -- intentionally out of scope.
secondary_config_headlines.metric: first-query latency vs same-fold baseline (2d async), 10-seed LOSO, mean + 95% CI

configs.prior_work_same_budget: learned_markov_14 -6.7% [-15.8,+2.4] ~= 2f_top14 -7.2% [-15.2,+0.7] (both CI cross zero: no physical skew to learn); learned never beats frequency at equal budget
learned_markov_14 -23.2% [-37.3,-9.2] ~= 2f_top14 -22.8% [-37.2,-8.4] (CI excludes 0: physical hot leaf present); learned never beats frequency at equal budget

run_config_sha256_note: Deterministic sha256 over the canonical invocation_plan (sorted-key compact JSON). Pins the replay configuration; the executed OpenWhisk run_config (run_id/action_image_digest/etc. per run_config.schema.json) is authored at replay time, out of scope for this no-execution freeze.
keyed_strategy_plans_note: Generic keyed per-(workload,seed) strategy plans. 2e_K10 is the first consumer. Seeds 1-5,7-10 share one native selection (byte-identical to the in-repo master strategies/access/runs/hot2e_YC_orig_K10.csv); seed 6 diverges (hot leaf 24837 -> 18314), native source committed under config/plans/keyed/native_source/. Runtime replays these exact frozen bytes; the fork is never read at runtime. See config/plans/keyed/native_source/PROVENANCE.md. 2f_slru is the second consumer: the whole resident working set per seed (footprint varies by seed, interior half always the 92-page skeleton; all 10 per-seed native sources committed under config/plans/keyed/native_source/hotpages_yc_seed{N}.csv).
secondary_run_config_sha256_note: Deterministic sha256 over the canonical secondary_invocation_plan (sorted-key compact JSON), mirroring run_config_sha256. Distinct from the primary because the target strategy set differs (baseline anchor + 2e_K500, leaf_freq_K10, leaf_rand_K10, 2f_top102, learned_markov_102). The secondary matrix runs under a NEW schedule_seed=20260825 (distinct from the primary 20260804); the primary invocation_plan/run_config_sha256 are byte-frozen and unchanged.
workload_set_note: Authoritative set of workload IDs the portability matrix (deployment complement) may address. ws2 05 unions this with the canonical id for its workload gate; session.py refuses any keyed plan for a workload outside this set. Additive to the primary/secondary YC campaigns, which are unaffected.
portability_run_config_sha256_note: Deterministic sha256 over the canonical portability_invocation_plan (sorted-key compact JSON). Independent identity for the workstation->OpenWhisk portability matrix (234 pairs / 468 invocations across 4 rectangular sub-matrices, schedule_seed=20260826). Distinct from the primary (022fbeb0...) and secondary (441609e6...) YC run configs, which are byte-frozen and untouched. Deployment/feasibility + footprint evidence only; warm paired first-query latency is NOT a strategy-performance estimate (see analysis/thesis/threats_to_validity.md).
